html:
Here is an image of the galaxy Messier 106, located 24 light-years away in the constellation Canes Venatici.

The technical details
Date:  2011/04/06, 2011/04/07, 2011/04/08
Optical train = Takahashi Sky90 II @ F4.5 - IDAS-LPS filter - Canon xsi unfiltered
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the TheSky6 software and guided with phd, QHY5 and 50mm finder
Acquisition with BackyardEOS
Site: At home
38 exposures of 10 min for 380 minutes
Dark, flat and bias applied
Pre-processing and processing in PixInsight

Here is an enlargement of the galaxy Messier 106
